# Compiler-warning budget -- the committed baseline for C28.
#
# Generated by scripts/warning-budget.py. Each entry is `<count> <path> <linter>`.
#
# THE COUNTS ARE A CEILING AND MAY ONLY DECREASE. Never regenerate this file to make a
# genuine regression disappear: `--update` rewrites it wholesale from current findings and
# would bless the regression along with everything else -- the same failure mode C16's header
# warns about for scripts/nolints.json. To retire a warning, fix it and let the count drop in
# the same commit as the fix, with the `--update` diff visible in that commit.
#
# Every linter class observed in the tree MUST have a disposition row below. A class with no
# row is exit 2, not a silent pass -- that guard is what stops a future linter class being
# absorbed into this baseline by a routine `--update` without anyone reading it.
#
# Dispositions: blocking | advisory | pending
#   blocking  a warning of this class fails the gate
#   advisory  counted and reported, does not fail the gate
#   pending   NOT YET ANALYSED -- the gate cannot ship enforced while any row reads pending

# disposition deprecated blocking forward-compat debt; becomes a build error at the next bump
# disposition introMerge advisory style suggestion; fixed where it reads better, tolerated where not
# disposition linter.defProp blocking read at all 10 sites: every one is a Prop-valued test helper and no dependent unfolds any of them definitionally (each is only ever applied as a term), so def -> theorem changes no downstream proof; converted rather than tolerated
# disposition linter.unreachableTactic blocking fix or document via declaration-scoped `set_option ... in`
# disposition linter.unusedSectionVars blocking fix per declaration with the `omit [...] in` form Lean prints
# disposition linter.unusedSimpArgs blocking dead simp argument; safe to delete (no `<-` caveat in tree)
# disposition linter.unusedTactic blocking fix or document via declaration-scoped `set_option ... in`
# disposition linter.unusedVariables blocking rename to a `_`-prefixed binder; do not delete (arity)
#
# Baseline total: 7 warning(s) across 4 file(s).

# DELIBERATE RESIDUAL. Cause established, not guessed: DenseModelSurgery/ re-declares
# `variable [Fintype sig.preds] [DecidableEq sig.preds]` several times per file (7x in
# BadIntervals, 5x NoGaps, 4x Lemma5, 3x TruthTransfer), and each re-declaration
# reintroduces the instances for the REST of its section, so the block's span exceeds the
# declarations that actually need it. Per-declaration `omit` was iterated to its floor
# (348 -> 47 -> 10 -> 8 -> 7) and then only shuffled which instance is provably-unused --
# NoGaps went UP on one wave, TruthTransfer resurfaced on the next. The fix is to narrow
# the `variable` blocks, a structural refactor of a proof-heavy directory that the task
# which introduced this gate did not own. C28 still fails on any NEW path/linter pair and
# on any count above the entry below, so this cannot grow silently.
3 FormalSystem/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/DenseModelSurgery/BadIntervals.lean linter.unusedSectionVars
